method.name: coupled8192_cfg2_nfe32_prefix0half
method.time_sampler_note: 50%概率均匀覆盖尺度0，剩余50%均匀覆盖尺度1..9；映射floor(10*t)，端点1截到尺度9。教师策略与训练工程保持第二轮不变，以隔离时间分布。
method.train_notes: FM 训练器为自行重实现；超参（lr/steps/bs）为配套工程参数，须在证据中记录实际值。

hypothesis: Round2 learned teacher-prefix reconstructions while pure-noise outputs collapsed to repeated texture. Allocate50% time probability to prefix0, retaining50% across the other nine prefixes, to isolate whether training-input allocation can improve frozen one-step sampling within the same budget.

fixed_engineering.teacher_configuration: unchanged from round2, regenerated with same seed and full generation charge
